classification: DESCRIPTIVE ADDENDUM. NON-GATING. NO PASS/FAIL. NO TERMINAL LABEL. Does not replace, re-score, or amend the sealed win-rate verdict (ONE_DEFENDER_HARM_ONLY), which remains correct under its frozen binary-win criterion.
authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-21: run a tiny goal-volume addendum on the sealed rows. Predeclare only the paired Blue-goal difference and the paired margin difference, all four policy x pole cells, the same 96 paired seeds, no new simulation; report native and +1D means beside the intervals so magnitudes are interpretable; no gate, no new terminal label, no replacement of the sealed verdict.

POST_HOC_MOTIVATION_DISCLOSED.statement: This addendum exists because the exploratory failure-localization pass exposed two things about the sealed causal result: (1) Pole B was saturated natively (pi_A won 96/96, pi_B 95/96), so it had almost no room to show a benefit; (2) on Pole A the mean Blue score appeared to rise under +1D (pi_A 1.20 -> 1.97, pi_B 1.04 -> 1.97) while win rate stayed flat, because the frozen binary win endpoint stops registering once Blue has scored a single goal. The motivation is therefore post-hoc, and is labelled as such.
POST_HOC_MOTIVATION_DISCLOSED.what_was_already_seen_before_this_freeze: The localization output displayed, for each of the four cells, the per-arm MEAN Blue score, MEAN Red score, mean episode length, and the count of episodes that ran the full 240 ticks. So the direction and rough size of the Blue-goal point difference was known. What had NOT been computed before this freeze: any paired bootstrap interval for the Blue-goal difference, and the margin endpoint at all.

SOURCE.rows: DEFENDER_INJECTION_CAUSAL_BRIDGE_ROWS.csv, columns policy, pole, arm, seed, defender_id, steps, blue, red, win, margin. No simulation of any kind is run by this addendum.
SOURCE.bound_to_the_sealed_record_by: sha256 of the rows file must equal AUDIT.rows_sha256 in DEFENDER_INJECTION_CAUSAL_BRIDGE_RESULT.json, and that result's status must be SEALED. Any mismatch aborts before anything is reported.

ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.cells: pi_A and pi_B x Pole A and Pole B = 4 cells; the same 96 paired seeds (20900001-20900096) in every cell and both arms.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.delta_G: Delta G = G_Blue(+1D) - G_Blue(native), per seed: (blue goals in the +1D episode) - (blue goals in the native episode at the same seed); then averaged over the 96 seeds.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.delta_M: Delta M = (B - R)(+1D) - (B - R)(native), per seed, using each episode's final score margin; then averaged over the 96 seeds. Margin is verified to equal blue - red on every row before use.
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.statistics: paired bootstrap 95% interval over seeds, the same routine and settings as every other record in this line (experiments.run_routed_composition_outcome._bootstrap: 20000 resamples, alpha 0.05, rng seed 7).
ENDPOINTS_FROZEN.also_reported: the native mean and the +1D mean of Blue goals and of margin for each cell, so the magnitude of each difference is interpretable.

MEASUREMENT_STRUCTURE_DISCLOSED.goals_are_capped: The environment ends an episode when either team reaches the score limit (3), so Blue goals per episode lie in {0,1,2,3} and margin in [-3, 3]. A cell whose native mean is already near 3 has little room to rise; a 240-tick timeout with fewer than 3 goals is the other way an episode ends.
MEASUREMENT_STRUCTURE_DISCLOSED.episode_length_is_not_held_fixed: Episodes end early when a team reaches the cap, so arms can differ in length. Goals per EPISODE is what is compared, as the sealed win endpoint also compared per episode; this is not a per-tick rate.
MEASUREMENT_STRUCTURE_DISCLOSED.no_defender_slot_adjustment: Goals are team totals; nothing is attributed to or excluded for the overridden agent.

INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN.rule: Report each cell's two paired differences with their intervals, and the native and +1D means. Nothing further is computed: no resolved/unresolved flag, no threshold, no cell ranking, no composite, no terminal label.
INTERPRETATION_RULE_FROZEN.what_a_result_can_say: Whether Blue goal production and score margin differ between the arms on the same paired seeds, and by how much, in each of the four cells.
what_it_cannot_say: that +1D raises the probability of winning (the sealed win-rate endpoint is the endpoint for that, and it stands as sealed)
that the sealed verdict should change
why goal volume differs (mechanism needs a targeted intervention; the localization pass is descriptive only)
anything about a confirmatory claim: this is post-hoc and exploratory

NOT_AUTHORIZED: any pass/fail gate or terminal label based on the result
replacing or re-scoring the sealed ONE_DEFENDER_HARM_ONLY verdict
adding endpoints after seeing the result (the two above are the whole addendum)
editing or amending any sealed artifact or prior commit; the correction trail is a later record, not a rewrite
